metadata.title: PkgSteward
metadata.description: Scan, analyze and manage the Node.js/npm projects on this machine

home.title: Projects
home.emptyDescription: Node.js projects found on this machine will show up here once the ScannerModule (backend) is done.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Shared tokens and components for the interface. Every sample reads straight from the active theme: switch Light/Dark or the language in the top bar to see it change.

colors.title: Colors
colors.description: Background/foreground pairs of the active preset, shown side by side in both modes. Components use token names only, never color codes.

typography.title: Typography
typography.description: Hierarchy comes from size and weight, not color. The main typeface is Inter.
typography.sample: Scan and clean up the Node.js projects on this machine
typography.monoNote: Only for command logs, paths and version numbers

shape.title: Shape and spacing
shape.description: Corner radius, shadow, spacing and content width shared by every screen.

radius.title: Corner radius
radius.description: The whole scale derives from --radius (16px): change that one variable and every corner follows.

shadow.title: Shadow
shadow.description: Cards sit flat. Only modals and floating layers (menus, selects) cast a shadow.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: 8px base step; 4px and 6px are for tight gaps inside chips. Sections are 32px apart on mobile, 48px on tablet and 64px on desktop.

container.title: Content width
container.description: Content is at most 1280px wide, with 16px side gutters on mobile and 24px from 640px up.
